code:
python3 mylang.py tests/fibonacci.ml | head -5    # first five lines of output
python3 mylang.py tests/fibonacci.ml | wc -l      # count output lines
python3 mylang.py tests/fibonacci.ml | sort        # sort output lines
description: Three pipelines: the `|` operator sends the stdout of your interpreter to the stdin of head, wc, or sort.

steps.description: `|` sends the stdout of one command to the stdin of the next. Each line runs the interpreter and pipes its output into a different command.
`head -5` prints the first five lines of output.

title: Piping Output Through Other Commands
